role: Pure, clock-free rule for when the dashboard may ask the system for an App Store rating.
types: ReviewPromptPolicy: enum — thresholds, UserDefaults key names and shouldRequest(...)
toplevel: Only the enum; no stored state of its own. Callers read and write the two UserDefaults keys and pass the values in.

units.does: Returns true when baselineNights >= 5, a score is shown, the stored last-asked version differs from currentVersion, and the last ask (if any) is at least 120 days before now.

branches.effect: false (at most one ask per app version)

branches.cond: lastRequestedDate is set AND less than 120 days before now
